## Notes

Maxis 1992 (Amiga 1993), designed by Ken Karakotsios; players modify plant and animal genetics, design environments and ecosystems, change the world's physics, and control evolution; exclusive species Killer Penguin, Monkeyphant, Orgot; 1993 Codie award.
